name: Living Your Life
source:
You take a role of a teenager who spent most of his life around military bases due to his father's military career.
Now, you are entering the last quarter of your senior year, college will soon be upon you, and your father decided it was time to move back to your hometown. It's the best chance for a permanent school and a real life.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你扮演一个青少年的角色，由于他父亲的军事生涯，他一生的大部分时间都在军事基地度过。
现在，你即将进入高年级的最后一个季度，大学即将来临，你的父亲决定是时候搬回家乡了。这是获得永久学校和真正生活的最佳机会。​

[来自F95Zone]
